rundown: Hawks beat 36ers 103-97. Hawks came back: they were down 49-46 at the half. The 4th quarter decided it: Hawks won it 32-24.
Leading the way — 36ers: Bryce Cotton 28 pts, 9 ast; Nick Rakocevic 11 reb. Hawks: Makur Maker 23 pts, 13 reb; Milton Doyle 7 ast.
Where Hawks won it: they shot 51% to 43%, shot 41% from three to 34% and turned it over 5 times to 9.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 3:27 AM ET. It had 36ers 59% and Hawks 41%, projecting 36ers 100.4 – Hawks 97.8 (198.2 total, 36ers by 2.6).

Final: 36ers 97 – Hawks 103. Wrong winner: it had 36ers at 59%, and Hawks (41%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
36ers came in with a league-average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (7-6, 92.9 scored and 92.5 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 100.4, they scored 97 (−3.4 points, 3% under); projected to allow 97.8, they allowed 103 (+5.2 points, 5% over).

Hawks came in with a 3% above average attack and a 4% leakier than average defense (5-10, 97.5 scored and 104.7 allowed a game over 15 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 97.8, they scored 103 (+5.2 points, 5% over); projected to allow 100.4, they allowed 97 (−3.4 points, 3% under).

The bigger miss was Hawks' scoring (+5.2 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 200 against 198.2 projected (+1.8), about the 55th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Hawks by 6 against 36ers by 2.6 projected, about the 76th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.022 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +7.4 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 79 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.012 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: 36ers attack ×1.007, defense ×0.989 (3 games); Hawks attack ×1.008, defense ×1.010 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
